summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market share repurchases under the second tranche of its 2026 buyback program. From June 15 to June 19, 2026, the company bought 369,300 shares at an average price of NOK 319.62 per share (approx. $30/share, ~$11.1M total). The tranche runs May 19 to July 20, 2026, buying 1.84M shares (accumulated average NOK 346.90). After these transactions, Equinor holds 2.63% of its share capital as treasury stock, excluding employee savings plan shares. This is a pre-announced capital return program under EU Market Abuse Regulation. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Going forward, watch for the program's completion by July 20 and potential subsequent tranches or program increases.
